verdict.rationale: The engine is published on npm (`npm install playcanvas`; a runtime probe shows version 2.22.2 with about 48k weekly downloads). It can be used standalone, and `create-playcanvas` scaffolds Vite + TypeScript projects, which shows it importing and bundling into a standard web toolchain; `@playcanvas/react` and `@playcanvas/web-components` are also npm packages. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of tree-shaking or side-effect-free ESM builds, and independent hands-on corroboration of bundling into an existing project rather than a scaffolded one.
